For incoming PhD candidates
For incoming PhD candidates
This website is a starting point for those considering a PhD at Ghent University and those who would like to start their application.
https://www.ugent.be/phd/en
https://www.ugent.be/++resource++plone-logo.svg
Interested in doing doctoral research at Ghent University?
All applications need the explicit commitment of a Ghent University professor who will act as your PhD supervisor.
There are two possibilities to start a PhD:
Apply for an open PhD position
Approach a specific professor
Use this roadmap to discover all the relevant information and which steps you need to take.
